subject: Emotions
title: Salovey and Mayer's Model
description: Learn Salovey and Mayer's Model in one minute.

hook.text: Before Goleman made EQ famous, two psychologists quietly built the real scientific framework behind it.

buildup.text: Peter Salovey and John Mayer coined 'emotional intelligence' in 1990—five years before Goleman's bestseller.

discovery.text: Their model has four branches: perceiving emotions, using them to think, understanding them, and managing them.

twist.text: Goleman's popular model mixed EQ with personality traits. Salovey-Mayer's stays closer to testable cognitive ability.

climax.text: The MSCEIT test measures EQ as ability, not self-report. You can't fake high EQ on it like you can on surveys.

punchline.text: EQ isn't just a buzzword. It's a measurable mental ability.
